# Dialog

Keeps attention on the task at hand, then returns you to where you were.

## Basic usage

<DemoPreview name="dialog" />

## API

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | boolean | false | Updated through v-model:open |
| `title` | string | Required | Accessible title |
| `description` | string | Required | Explains the task |
| `closeLabel` | string | '关闭对话框' | Accessible name of the close button |

### Events

- `update:open(boolean)`

### Slots

- trigger: a single focusable trigger element
- default: content
- footer: action area

## Keyboard and usage notes

Opening moves focus into the dialog, Tab cycles within it, and Escape closes it and returns focus to the trigger. Use the trigger slot so focus can return.

## Installation

```ts
import { AgmDialog } from 'augma'
import 'augma/style.css'
```

Copy the editable source:

```sh
pnpm dlx shadcn-vue@2.8.2 add https://augma.yunyoujun.cn/r/dialog.json
```
